name: github-actions
// why: Nx lint targets are per-project, and .github/actions belonged to no project -- so both gates that matter (ci.yml's `pnpm lint`, and the pre-push hook's `nx affected -t lint`) skipped every composite action's JavaScript. Nothing was ignoring it; nobody was asking for it. The dispatch broker has since moved to apps/dispatch-broker; rerun-infra-killed-runs remains here, and this project is what keeps it linted.
